description.en:
Change the fence type of any animal pasture (sheep, cows, pigs, horses, chickens) to any fence available in your game, including fences from other mods.
When placing a new barn or pasture in construction mode, press the "Pasture fence" button to pick its fence. The preview updates right away and the barn is built with that fence.
To change an existing pasture, stand inside it on foot and press the activate key ("Change pasture fence"). Pick a fence from the list, or "Original fence" to go back. The fence keeps its shape and the choice is saved with your savegame.
Notes: - Singleplayer only. - If the chosen fence has no gate, existing gates are left as openings. - Fences with long panels may leave small gaps at corners.
